# Published WirePlumber policy fixtures

These are the unmodified policy files from the immutable source asset
`quantum-20260820.rfc1.s1148921.tar.gz` in release
`rfc-20260820.rfc1.s1148921`. Native revisions through 4 used the same bytes.

Keep these fixtures unchanged when updating current templates. They exercise
migration from the published installer, including preservation of edited copies.
